proposed_widenings.name: composite_magic_item_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The item simultaneously grants a passive resistance effect and a separate charge-based spellcasting activation, but MagicItemMechanics currently allows only one family at a time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You have Resistance to Cold damage while you hold this staff." / "The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_staff_of_frost.dhall because any current encoding would have to omit either the passive cold resistance or the activated spellcasting half. Existing atoms appear sufficient once the magic-item mechanics shape can compose both families.
